text.tspan: How a developer reaches a private database (best first)
no SSH port, no public IP
SSM document: AWS-StartPortForwardingSessionToRemoteHost (forwards localhost:5432 to the RDS endpoint).
Also: read-only DB users for developers, and no direct production access.
